data.name: Aruabea
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Aruabea is a name for a nymph born from the earth. She was a guardian of springs and a protector of agriculture. Her name is derived from the Greek words 'aros' meaning 'mountain' and 'bios' meaning 'life'.
